versions.subject: add powershell_trigger_profiles
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 4104
    ScriptBlockText|contains|all:
        - 'Add-Content'
        - '$profile'
        - '-Value' 
    ScriptBlockText|contains: 
        - 'Start-Process'
        - '""'  #cleanup action
condition: selection
versions.spl: EventID=4104 ScriptBlockText="*Add-Content*" ScriptBlockText="*$profile*" ScriptBlockText="*-Value*" ScriptBlockText IN ("*Start-Process*", "*\"\"*")
